verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any registrable outbound HTTP callback that pushes Zulip events to an external consumer. The only webhook mention is 'Incoming webhooks' (zulip-docs-19), which carries data in the opposite direction, into Zulip. The bot framework and Botserver (zulip-docs-4, zulip-docs-18) are developer building blocks for bots that react to messages, not a documented event-subscription webhook feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
